name: show-a-commit

steps.command: echo two > a.txt; echo b > b.txt

steps.stdout:
commit <c1*>

    first

diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+one

commit <c2*>

    second

diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-one
+two
diff --git a/b.txt b/b.txt
--- a/b.txt
+++ b/b.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+b

steps.stderr: ws-git: show takes one ref (a commit from ws-git log), or <ref>:<path> for one file at that state. usage: ws-git show <ref>[:<path>]; see 'ws-git help'
ws-git: 'main' is this session, not a commit: ws-git show HEAD shows your last commit, and ws-git log lists the others.

summary: show prints a commit's message and its change, by the short id the log printed or HEAD.
